_doc: Regex rules applied to each new line of %LOCALAPPDATA%\DeadByDaylight\Saved\Logs\DeadByDaylight.log (a fresh file is written every launch; older ones are renamed *-backup-*). NOTHING here is verified yet: the exact log lines for map load / match start are unknown and may change per patch. Workflow: record a real session (docs/DATA_COLLECTION.md), run `uv run python tools/log_probe.py <log>`, then add rules below with verified=true and the patch you verified on. Never add rules that reveal information the player could not otherwise see (e.g. the killer's identity or loadout before the match) - see docs/FAIR_PLAY.md.
_token_hint: Wiki map icon files are named 'IconMap <Abc>_<MapName>' (e.g. IconMap_Hos_Treatment, IconMap_Swp_ThePaleRose, IconMap_Sub_Street). Internal map tokens in the log may follow the same Prefix_Name shape - confirm before relying on it.
